We need number of CH3 groups in the molecule. But we don't have the molecule given. Possibly the sample is the one we have access to via NMR tools. We can get proton NMR spectra to infer number of methyl groups. Or carbon NMR. The task likely expects to count methyl groups from NMR data. Use proton_nmr_spectra to get peaks; methyl groups appear as singlet (or doublet etc) around 0.9-1.5 ppm with integration of 3H. But we don't have integration data. The tool returns spectra as string maybe includes integration.

We need to call proton_nmr_spectra.
